verdict.rationale: Salesmate's own marketing copy says it manages contacts, companies, and activities in one place, so the core record types exist. Nothing documents that contacts and companies are linked to each other or that each record shows a full activity timeline. Missing for 10: documented contact-to-company record linking, per-record activity timeline view, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each

citations.quote: Manage contacts, companies, deals, pipelines, activities, and conversations in one place.
Update CRM records, fields, and activities autonomously without manual intervention
